Name: Hyper Realistic Coins
Author: undare
Description:
[b][size=4][color=#ff7700]Hyper[/color] [color=#ffd966]Realistic [/color][color=#f1c232]Coins [/color]![/size]


[size=5][color=#93c47d]About [/color]:[/size]

[size=3]Pelican Town is famous enough to get his own type of currency.[/size]
[size=3](This changes the [/size][color=#e69138]money [/color][size=3]icon and the [/size][color=#f1c232]Money-reward[/color][size=3] sprite)[/size]

[size=3]It requires Content Patcher animations... But there are options to turn off the animations (for static sprites).[/size]
[size=3]It is default to have animations.[/size]

[size=5]
[color=#d5a6bd]Installation [/color]:[/size]
[b][size=3]-Download the requirements above[/size][/b]
[size=3]-Unpack this file inside stardewvalley/mods folder[/size]



[/b][b][size=5][color=#6d9eeb]Config [/color]:[/size]

[size=3]You can choose from 8 coin options in the[/size][color=#6d9eeb] config file[/color][size=3] :   (Added a txt file for easy copy pasting for other type of keyboards)[/size]

[/b][b][size=3]////////////////////////////////[/size]
[color=#f6b26b][size=4]Coin[/size][/color][size=3]:[/size]

[size=3]"[color=#f1c232]Basic_gold[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]A more refined version of the original coin engraved with beautiful patterns.[/size]


[size=3]"[color=#f1c232]Flowers_and_rivers_gold[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]The conmemorative coin in celebration of all the seasons where  you can grow crops, but winter.[/size]
[size=3]Adorned with a field full of flowers, 4 types of grass and a farmer stealing a chicken.[/size]

[size=3]"[color=#f1c232]Polished[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]Made with 200% more gold, filled inside with diamonds to bring luck to the user.[/size]


[size=3]"[color=#f1c232]Junimo_gold[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]One of our favorites!  It pictures the mystical creature of the valley : "The wild Marshmellow"[/size]


[size=3]"[color=#f1c232]junimo_rare_gold[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]In one of the impressions, a very rare coin was produced for accident, portraying 2 half marshmellows looking to each other.[/size]
[size=3]We can now do that accident on prupose for mass production, making the collectors cry and roll in the parsnip fields.[/size]


[size=3]"[color=#a4c2f4]refined_silver[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]A Silver....   coin...   yes![/size]


[size=3]"[color=#a4c2f4]refined_junimo_silver[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]A  beautifully refined silver coin, engraved with the wild marshmellow dancing in the starry night, while moonlight jellies swim in the distant beach.[/size]



[size=3]"[color=#dd7e6b]tacos[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]"It was my idea!"   -Lewis[/size]
[size=3] [/size]


[size=3]"[color=#dd7e6b]false[/color]"[/size]
[size=3]I guess we can take a gold nugget, smash it once with a hammer into a gold tortilla and thats it.[/size]
[size=3](This disables the mod)[/size]

[size=3]///////////////////////////////////[/size]
[color=#f6b26b][size=4]Animations [/size][/color][size=3]:   ///to turn on or off the animations / Need CP-Animations  /   Default : "true"[/size]

[size=3]true [/size]
[size=3]false[/size]
[size=3]////////////////////////////////////[/size]
[color=#f6b26b][size=4]PileAnimations [/size][/color][size=3]:     //There is a pile of money sprite for rewards.  This enables/disabled the sparkle animations (Very pretty tho) 
Default : "true"[/size]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿///Also, the 3 piles of new currency are replaced with each respective coin above for static images in automatic.

[size=3]true[/size]
[size=3]false[/size]
[size=3]/////////////////////////////////////

[/size][color=#cc4125][size=4]Conflict [/size][/color][size=4][color=#f4f4f4]:[/color]
-------------------------------------------
If you have  "[color=#a4c2f4]Starblue[/color]"   
It will replace this mod.
So you may want to go to [color=#a4c2f4]Starblue [/color]config file and change "Interface" to "false".
Or..
You can add a dependecy. so my mod load last.
